name: Go SDE-2 / SSE-1 interview prep

splits.DSA: 15 min: clear due reviews. 105 min: 3 new problems, about 35 min each. Stuck at 25 min? Read the approach, code it yourself, rate it Struggled.
splits.Go: 90 min: study with code open, typing every example. 30 min: notes in your own words and a self-quiz.
splits.Backend: 90 min: study with code open, typing every example. 30 min: notes in your own words and a self-quiz.
splits.LLD: 90 min: timed build from a blank repo. 30 min: review against a checklist (interfaces, concurrency safety, tests, naming).
splits.Design: 45 min: write the design end to end. 30 min: compare with a reference. 45 min: go deep on the weakest component.
splits.Mock: 45–60 min per mock, then the debrief. Log it under Mocks.
splits.Review: 45 min: clear every due review. 30 min: revise this block's topics. 45 min: this block's job-search task.
